verdict.rationale: Carta documents an official MCP setup guide (claude-mcp-setup) with pre-built plugins that connect an agent to a Carta account. The Cap Table plugin covers ownership, SAFEs, grants and 409As, and the Investors plugin covers NAV, fund performance and partner data. The probe confirms this official MCP server documentation exists. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the server works, documentation of agent clients beyond Claude, and transport, endpoint and auth details for the MCP connection.
